review_candidates.description: At Transmed, we continue to transform our digital landscape to maximize value for our business, customers, and suppliers through the implementation, management, and support of strategic, business-fit technologies, digital capabilities, data, and business intelligence solutions. We are currently seeking a highly analytical and driven Business Intelligence Senior Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and implementing advanced business intelligence solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and regional functions to deliver impactful insights and scalable reporting solutions. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business intelligence and reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions and actionable deliverables. Design, develop, and maintain BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, or similar platforms. Integrate and analyze data from multiple sources including SQL databases, Excel files, APIs, and third-party applications. Build and maintain ETL processes, data pipelines, and data workflows to ensure efficient and reliable data movement. Design and optimize data models, data warehouses, and data lakes to support scalable reporting and analytics. Write advanced SQL queries, scripts, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and load data efficiently. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, consistency, and governance across reporting and analytics environments. Monitor and troubleshoot BI reports, dashboards, data pipelines, and data sources to resolve issues proactively. Deliver clear and impactful insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through data storytelling and visualization. Process, clean, and validate large datasets for analysis and reporting purposes. Continuously stay updated on emerging BI, analytics, cloud, and data technologies and recommend best practices. Support organizational change management initiatives and ensure adherence to company policies and standards. Qualifications & Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Master’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline is a plus. Minimum 3+ years of progressive experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting, or Data Engineering. Strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or QlikView. Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with database management systems such as SQL Server or Oracle. Good understanding of ETL processes, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts. Experience with Python and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS is considered an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to communicate complex data insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working in fast-paced and collaborative environments; FMCG industry experience is preferred. What We’re Looking For A proactive and detail-oriented professional with a passion for data and business transformation. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. If you are passionate about turning data into meaningful business insights and want to be part of a dynamic digital transformation journey, we would love to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Flight Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Sateliot is a Barcelona-based satellite company with one goal: connect everything, everywhere. Founded in 2018, we've built the first satellite constellation that lets standard commercial devices communicate directly from space. Our technology bridges the gaps that terrestrial networks will never reach, bringing affordable and secure connectivity to industries, governments, and communities across the planet. Learn more: https://sateliot.space/ About The Team & This Role The Mission and Systems Engineering team is responsible for the development, integration and validation of the satellite’s core avionics and on-board software, ensuring reliable operation across all spacecraft subsystems. As Flight Software Engineer, you’ll own the On-Board Software (OBSW) for Sateliot’s satellites — from today’s baseline to the next generation — developing, verifying and validating it, and supporting the platform through integration campaigns and in orbit, working closely with the Systems, Hardware, AIT and Operations teams. What you'll do Own the development of the on-board flight software for the platform, through to a flight-ready release. Own its verification and validation: define and run the unit, integration and system-level test campaigns that produce the acceptance evidence for each release. Deliver software that is robust and reliable in the space environment. Own the integration of the on-board software with the satellite subsystems, interfaces and overall system architecture, working closely with the Hardware, Systems and AIT teams. Resolve issues across software, hardware, interfaces and communication protocols, from the bench and AIT campaigns through to in-orbit operations. What you bring 5+ years developing embedded software in C or C++ for resource-constrained targets. Hands-on development on real-time operating system (FreeRTOS, RTEMS, VxWorks or equivalent). Hands-on development on data interfaces used in satellite systems (SpaceWire, CAN Bus, RS-422, RS-485, Ethernet, MIL-STD-1553). Demonstrated ownership of embedded software verification: authored unit and integration test suites and executed them on target hardware. Bonus if you have Python or other modern scripting languages, applied to test automation and tooling. Familiarity with ECSS and CCSDS standards. Experience developing software for aerospace or safety-critical systems. Experience with CI/CD for embedded systems. Experience with Linux, Git and modern software development workflows. Experience running FlatSat and hardware-in-the-loop test campaigns. Experience working in a cleanroom environment, or willingness to. Previous involvement in satellite AIT/AIV, commissioning, or in-orbit operations. Additional requirements Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate: this is a hybrid role with regular on-site presence at our Barcelona HQ, where the hardware benches and FlatSat are. Availability for occasional travel to external test campaigns, and for extended hours around launch and in-orbit commissioning windows. How we work We lead with humility, move fast, and take ownership. We collaborate without ego and measure ourselves by real impact, not titles or hierarchy. We hire people who already live these values. What we offer Real impact on one of Europe’s most ambitious space projects. Growth: we cover 50% of courses or master’s degrees (up to 5% of your salary), plus Spanish and Catalan classes. Health & balance: 50% on private health insurance and Urban Sports Club, a flexible schedule, and hybrid work, we focus on results, not hours. Flexible Compensation: flexible compensation through Cobee (meal, transport, kindergarten). A truly global team: 20+ nationalities building something genuinely new - and genuinely nice to work with. Great vibes, real teamwork. A real welcome: a dedicated buddy from day one. Life outside work: we organize leisure and sports activities both during and outside working hours - because great teams connect beyond the screen. Catering: if you don't have time to cook, we partner with a catering company so a freshmeal is sorted, no need to think about it. Parking: on-site parking at the office, with Sateliot covering 50% of the cost - plus free bike parking if you prefer to pedal in. Sound like you? Apply now! Sateliot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs, without discrimination on the basis of any legally protected characteristic.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer
review_candidates.company: MCS Group - USA | Your Specialist Recruitment Firm
review_candidates.description: Software Engineer Greater Boston | Onsite near Dedham, MA What if your next software role wasn't about joining a team to maintain something that already exists? What if you could actually help build what comes next? I'm working with a long-established global business operating at the intersection of technology, secure manufacturing and digital products . They support some of the world's most recognizable organizations, producing both physical and digital solutions used in highly secure, regulated environments. But this isn't a traditional manufacturing technology environment. They're in the middle of a major transformation, modernizing platforms, consolidating legacy systems, building new digital products and using AI to completely rethink how the business operates. And they're building the engineering team to do it. The Role They're looking for a Software Engineer with around 1-4 years of experience to join the team. Rather than hiring narrowly against one specific product or team, they're interested in meeting strong engineers and figuring out where their experience, interests and strengths fit best. You could be working on: New customer-facing platforms and digital products Modernizing and replacing legacy systems Data and analytics platforms Content and document technology APIs and integrations Internal platforms that support global manufacturing and operations AI-enabled tools and applications Building entirely new products from the ground up There's a real opportunity here to grow into ownership of a product, problem or domain , rather than simply picking up tickets from a backlog. The engineering organization itself is still evolving, so the people joining now will have a genuine influence over how things are built. The Right Person This is where things are a little different. The exact tech stack matters less than how you think . They want engineers who are curious, technically strong and naturally inclined to build things. People who see a problem and start thinking: "There has to be a better way to do this." You'll likely have around 1-4 years of software engineering experience . What matters more is that you: Have strong backend or full-stack foundations Enjoy solving ambiguous problems and figuring things out Can work with business teams and understand what actually needs to be built Want more ownership and responsibility Learn new technologies quickly Are comfortable working in an environment where not everything has already been defined Are actively using AI in your development workflow, or experimenting with it yourself See AI as something that changes how software is built, not simply another tool on the list If you're the person experimenting with Claude, Copilot, agents, automation or new frameworks before someone tells you to, you'll probably fit in well here. Technology There isn't one rigid stack. The current environment includes technologies such as: React / Angular | .NET | Azure | REST APIs | Microservices | CI/CD | GitHub Copilot | Claude Code But strong engineers coming from backgrounds such as Java, AWS, GCP or other modern object-oriented/backend environments will absolutely be considered. They would rather hire someone with strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than reject a great person because they have AWS instead of Azure on their resume. Why This One Is Interesting You're joining an established business with global customers and real-world products - but the technology environment has almost a startup mentality . There are decades of systems to modernize, entirely new products to build and significant investment going into technology and AI. That means there is a lot of space to make an impact. You could join at Software Engineer level and grow into ownership of a major product area because you saw an opportunity and ran with it. There aren't layers of committees deciding exactly what you are allowed to work on. If you're currently feeling underused, boxed into a narrow role or like one engineer among thousands , this could be a very different environment. Location These roles are based onsite in the Greater Boston area, near Dedham, MA . The team is intentionally building an in-person engineering culture because of the speed of development, collaboration required and the close connection between technology and the physical operations of the business. If you like the idea of actually sitting with the people you're building for, seeing the operation firsthand and having conversations that turn into products, this environment makes a lot of sense. review_candidates.description: ABOUT US You will work on a smart consumer IoT product. Thousands of devices are already in use in customers' homes, and new products are in development. THE ROLE We are looking for an engineer who knows both ends of the same chain: the ESP32 S3 firmware on the device and the AWS backend it talks to. Someone who designs protocols, finds field bugs, and doesn't need to convince anyone to change an interface. Firmware — features across sensors, camera trigger, RFID and low-power sleep; OTA for a 20,000-device fleet; faster on-device TFLite inference; production flashing and test tooling. Backend — AWS IoT Core (device shadow / commands, provisioning), Lambda and DynamoDB services, Terraform IaC and multi-account setup, fleet health monitoring. Across both — you chase "device sends no events" from firmware through radio, shadow and Lambda down to the data model, and you define the contracts with our external mobile developers and our AI engineer. Architecture decisions go straight to the CTO, no layers in between. Stack: C/C++ · Python · AWS · ESP32-S3 · Terraform · TensorFlow / PyTorch YOU BRING Fundamentals, motivation and follow-through matter more to us than deep knowledge of any specific technology. If you understand how systems really work, you'll pick up our stack quickly - so read the list below as context, not as a checklist. Solid fundamentals — you know what happens beneath the abstractions: memory, concurrency, networking, data modelling. That's what transfers between stacks Ownership and drive — you take a problem, make the call, and carry it to done without waiting for tickets. Highly motivated, fast-moving, and you finish what you start A security mindset — you think about what a leaked key, an unsigned image or an over-permissive policy does to a fleet of 20,000 devices, and you'd rather close the gap than document it Senior-level firmware or backend experience, with genuine interest in the other half. Equally strong in both on day one isn't the expectation; wanting to work in both is C/C++ on microcontrollers (ideally ESP-IDF) and/or Python or Node.js with hands-on AWS A feel for devices that live in customers' homes: OTA, telemetry, remote diagnostics, and the instinct not to brick hardware Debugging across system boundaries — logic analyzer and device logs through to CloudWatch Fluent English is a must, German a plus Nice to have: embedded security in depth (secure boot, TLS mutual auth, certificate and key handling), deep AWS IoT Core, Terraform, TinyML and model quantization, low-power design, MCU camera pipelines, consumer IoT or startup experience. WHAT WE OFFER Fully remote work from Serbia with competitive compensation Speed: what you build ships to 20,000+ devices within weeks A team that takes technical excellence seriously — we'd rather do it properly than ship debt Hardware and AI tools provided Long term, stable project
